title: SkillBrowser: Selective Skill Exposure for Scalable Skill-Using Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.23554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on skills to extend their capabilities in complex tasks. However, scalable skill use requires Selective Skill Exposure (SSE): providing relevant procedural content when needed while avoiding unnecessary exposure that may disrupt reasoning. Existing paradigms fall short in complementary ways. Progressive disclosure exposes metadata for a growing skill library, introducing context pollution; retrieval limits catalog exposure, but static retrieval from the initial task query may be misaligned with capability needs that emerge during reasoning and may still inject unnecessary skills. We propose SkillBrowser, a Meta-Skill-managed framework that enables an agent to identify current capability needs, formulate targeted queries, and selectively load skills on demand. translated_title: SkillBrowser：面向可扩展技能型智能体的选择性技能暴露
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型智能体日益依赖技能来扩展其在复杂任务中的能力。然而，可扩展的技能使用需要选择性技能暴露：在需要时提供相关的程序性内容，同时避免可能干扰推理的不必要暴露。现有范式在不同方面存在不足：渐进式披露会暴露不断增长的技能库的元数据，从而引入上下文污染；检索虽然限制了目录暴露，但基于初始任务查询的静态检索可能与推理过程中出现的能力需求不匹配，且仍可能注入不必要的技能。我们提出SkillBrowser，一个由元技能管理的框架，使智能体能够识别当前的能力需求、制定有针对性的查询，并按需选择性地加载技能。在六个SRA-Bench子集和五个大语言模型上，SkillBrowser的总体准确率优于静态检索和基于LLM的选择方法。
tldr: SkillBrowser提出了一种由元技能管理的选择性技能暴露框架，使智能体能够自主识别当前能力需求并按需加载技能，在六个SRA-Bench子集和五个大语言模型上的总体准确率均优于静态检索与基于LLM的选择方法。
en_tdlr: SkillBrowser is a Meta-Skill-managed framework that enables agents to identify their current capability needs and selectively load skills on demand, improving aggregate accuracy over static retrieval and LLM-based selection across six SRA-Bench subsets and five LLMs.
